readerCopy.body: A routine conflict can become a high-stakes power struggle once winning starts to matter more than the original issue. When Mars conjoins Pluto, action and power intensify each other, making force, leverage, and control unusually difficult to separate from the desired outcome. Escalation can spend resources that the actual goal still needs later. The strongest action is the one that protects the priority without turning every disagreement into a contest of dominance.
